QuestInfo.0: Now that you've caught up to #b#p3002020##k, leader of the Fox Point Rangers, he's ready to give you your first mission! Talk to him in #b#m410000110##k to find out what it is!
QuestInfo.1: For your first mission, #b#p3002020##k says he needs #r#i4036315# #t4036315# x50#k from the #b#o2400251##k monsters in #b#m410000111##k.
QuestInfo.2: After all that hard work to collect materials, turns out #b#p3002020##k's just going to make a sneezing powder out of it. Pulling pranks doesn't seem like a very good way to protect the village...
